discussion_comments.comment_body: Real gap, good catch. The intercept lived only in nonStreamingHandler, so a forced-streaming provider would hide the search call inside the SSE and hand the client back an unanswered tool call. Fixed in a4e8066: handleForcedSSEToJson now receives the fallback plan via sharedCtx and applies applyWebSearchFallback at all three client-format return sites (Responses-native passthrough, chat/gemini-built body, and the chat-SSE converted body). The call is internally guarded, so requests with no plan pass straight through. One nuance: a Claude-format client never reaches this path with a claude-shape body (the translator converts before dispatch), so extractHandledCalls seeing only openai/claude shapes is fine here. Regression test added at tests/unit/forced-sse-websearch-intercept.test.js covering chat and Responses clients on both SSE sources.
Fixed in 46ebf215: the Responses probe now accepts 2xx plus explicit transient statuses (408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504). It rejects 405, 410, and 422; focused tests cover these cases.

Fixed in 46ebf215: incomplete Responses output now suppresses partial tool calls and reports `length` or `content_filter` before considering completed tool calls. Tests cover both truncation reasons with partial tool output.
